test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of:

1. Elected members of both the Houses of Parliament i.e. Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha

2. Elected members of State Legislative Assemblies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**both 1 and 2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• According to Article 55 of the Constitution, there should be, as far as possible, uniformity in the scale of representation of different states in the election of the President. To achieve such uniformity among the states, the number of votes each state is entitled to be determined as follows:
 
 
• Each elected member of the Legislative Assembly of a State shall have as many votes as there are in the quotient obtained by dividing the population of the State multiple of one thousand by the total number of elected members of the Legislative Assembly;
 
• If, after taking the said multiples of one thousand, the remainder is not less than five hundred, the vote of each member shall be further increased by one; (c) Each elected member of either House of Parliament shall have a such number of votes as may be obtained by dividing the total number of votes assigned to the members of the State Legislative Assemblies by the total of the elected members of both the Houses of Parliament Counting more than one and a half fractions by number as one and disregarding other fractions.
 
 
 
• The President shall be elected according to the system of proportional representation by the single transferable vote and by secret ballot.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** President of India is the head of state of the Republic of India.**
 
• The President is the nominal head of the executive, the country's first civilian, and the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• **Draupadi Murmu is the 15th and current President,** having assumed office on **25 July 2022 at AM.**
 
• The office of the President was created when India officially became a republic on 26 January 1950, after gaining independence on 15 August 1947, when its constitution came into force. The President is elected indirectly by an electoral college consisting of both the Houses of the Parliament of India and the Legislative Assemblies of each of the states and territories of India, which the citizens themselves directly elect.
